versification: R. H. Charles source numbering normalized to logical chapters 1-108 and contiguous integer verses; lettered subverses and parallel E/G^g readings are preserved in merged text/source_parts

verses.text_en: And these are the names of the holy angels who watch.
verses.text_hr: Ovo su imena svetih anđela koji bdiju.

verses.text_en: Uriel, one of the holy angels, who is over the world and over Tartarus.
verses.text_hr: Uriel, jedan od svetih anđela, nad svijetom i Tartarom.

verses.text_en: Raphael, one of the holy angels, who is over the spirits of men.
verses.text_hr: Rafael, jedan od svetih anđela, nad duhovima ljudi.

verses.text_en: Raguel, one of the holy angels who †takes vengeance on† the world of the luminaries.
verses.text_hr: Raguel, jedan od svetih anđela, koji †se osvećuje nad† svijetom svjetlila.

verses.text_en: Michael, one of the holy angels, to wit, he that is set over the best part of mankind 〚and〛 over chaos.
verses.text_hr: Mihael, jedan od svetih anđela, onaj koji je postavljen nad najboljim dijelom čovječanstva 〚i〛 nad kaosom.

verses.text_en: Saraqâêl, one of the holy angels, who is set over the spirits, who sin in the spirit.
verses.text_hr: Sarakael, jedan od svetih anđela, postavljen nad duhovima koji griješe u duhu.

verses.text_en: Gabriel, one of the holy angels, who is over Paradise and the serpents and the Cherubim.
verses.text_hr: Gabriel, jedan od svetih anđela, nad Rajem, zmijama i kerubinima.

verses.text_en: Remiel, one of the holy angels, whom God set over those who rise.
verses.text_hr: Remiel, jedan od svetih anđela, kojega je Bog postavio nad one koji ustaju.
